mapper.select:
SELECT T1.PORTFOLIO_ID code, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID name, T1.PORTFOLIO_NAME shortName, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID hidCode FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO T1 INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY T2 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T2.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T2.USER_ID = #{userId}
T1.PORTFOLIO_ID like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%')) or T1.PORTFOLIO_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{param},'%'))

SELECT T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T1.VDATE vdate, T1.MDATE mdate, T6.TYPE_6 assetType1, T6.TYPE_7 assetType2, T1.CCY ccy, T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, T3.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, T1.PS ps, T1.PRICE price, T1.PRICE_MODEL priceModel, T1.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, T4.BOARD board, T5.DEAL_MODE dealMode, T5.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId, T1.ENTRUST_AMT entrustAmt, T1.ENTRUST_NUM entrustNum, T1.PRO_AVAILABLE_CASH proAvailableCash, T1.ACC_AVAILABLE_CASH accAvailableCash, T1.REMARK remark, T1.COUNTER_ID counterId, T1.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, T1.CONTACT_INFO contactInfo, T2.TRADER trader, T1.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, T1.CHL_ID chlId, T1.SALE_CODE saleCode FROM ETR_ENTRUST T1 LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE T2 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T2.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T5 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T5.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T6 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID
T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
SELECT CLOSE_PRICE FROM (SELECT * FROM MST_SHARE_PRICE WHERE SHARES_ID = #{finprodMarketId} AND DEAL_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{sysdate},'yyyy-mm-dd') ORDER BY DEAL_DATE DESC) WHERE ROWNUM =1
